request.prompt: Image 1 is the character reference sheet for the masked person. Black-and-white high-key 35mm film photograph, overexposed and airy, blown-out whites, heavy film grain, faint photocopy halftone texture, slight softness, editorial fashion photography. Everything is monochrome grey EXCEPT the green paper ghost mask, which stays saturated green — the only colour in the picture. Lots of empty white negative space. Compose for a 16:9 crop. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Close-up profile: the masked person exactly as in the reference image: a boxy green crumpled-paper pixel ghost mask covering the whole head, two black plus-sign eyes, pixel zigzag bottom edge; chunky off-white pixel-block headphones with a small black boom microphone; oversized beige hoodie, wide black jeans, white sneakers seen from the side, one hand raised pressing the off-white pixel headphone ear cup against the mask, as if turning the music up. Only the mask, the hand and the headphone in frame, cut off by the left edge, rest is white.
